metadata.title: Stubbornly high inflation isn't the only thing threatening to derail Wall Street's recovery rally - MarketWatch

content.text:
19 hours ago
Stubbornly high inflation isn't the only thing threatening to derail Wall Street's recovery rally
Hot inflation isn't the only thing putting a damper on Wall Street's recovery mood.
Blame Nvidia and other chip stocks, too. Shares of Nvidia were giving back gains in premarket action to extend their decline from the previous day. The stock was falling a further 4% on Tuesday as investors continued to weigh the potential fallout from CEO Jensen Huang’s affair with an alleged Chinese spy.
Other semiconductor names were also getting hammered. Micron Technology was off 1.6%, Super Micro Computer was falling 1.7% and Oracle was also down 1.2%, according to FactSet data.
